mods.name: PolyHorn
mods.description: Teleportation horns - use them to teleport to your spawn point or to a saved location.

releases.notes:
## Highlights
- Horns of Return now reject saved locations that are unavailable, outside spawnable bounds, or outside the destination world's border instead of attempting the teleport.

## Improvements
- Spectators can activate framed horns to inspect their destinations, while held horns remain unavailable to spectators.
- Return-point lore is updated in place when a horn is reused, preserving the rest of the horn's lore.
- `/polyhorn give` now delivers horns to players with full inventories by dropping them for pickup and reports the number of targeted players.

## Bug fixes
- Horn teleports now apply cooldowns to the horn that was used.

## Compatibility
- The supported minimum Fabric Loader version is now `0.19.5`.
- The supported minimum Fabric API version is now `0.159.0+26.2`.


**Full changelog:** [v1.1.0...v1.2.0](https://github.com/RenardElectric/PolyHorn/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0)

releases.notes:
## New features
- Added interactive `/polyhorn help` output with clickable command shortcuts and usage links. Each command also has a `help` form showing its syntax, required and optional arguments, and whether it is admin-only.

## Improvements
- Improved horn cooldown command feedback: queries show the current value and valid range, successful changes show before-and-after values, and errors use consistent formatted messages.
- Updated PolyHorn command messages with consistent formatting and a clickable link from the base command to the command list.


**Full changelog:** [v1.0.3...v1.1.0](https://github.com/RenardElectric/PolyHorn/compare/v1.0.3...v1.1.0)
